Detection of target RNAs using branched DNA technology. Branched DNA technology for RNA detection can be coupled with confocal microscopy or flow cytometry. Target RNAs are first bound by pairs of Target Probes. Typically, twenty sets of target probe pairs are designed per target RNA. The Pre-Amplifier DNA only binds target probe pairs that are bound to target RNAs in the correct orientation; this greatly limits the signal to noise ratio. Pre-Amplifier DNAs are then bound by Amplifier DNAs and subsequently by Label Probes. This process results in the labeling of target RNAs by up to 8,000 fluorophores. Collection of codon-altered JFH1 virus stocks The pJFH1 plasmid encodes the full-length genome of the JFH1 strain of HCV. The wild-type plasmid and all codon-altered versions contain an XbaI cut site at the 3’ end of the genome. Digest 5 μg of plasmid DNA with 20 U of XbaI in the CutSmart Buffer provided in a final reaction volume of 25 μl. Incubate digestions at 37 °C for 2 h. Purify linearized DNA using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit, as per manufacturer’s protocol. Using 1 μg of linearized plasmid as your template, perform in vitro transcription with the MEGAscript T7 kit to make full-length genomic viral RNA. Incubate in vitro transcription reaction at 37 °C for 6 h. The temperature and duration of this incubation can be altered for optimal yield of individual transcripts. Isolate synthesized viral RNA using Trizol as per the manufacturer’s protocol. Resuspend vRNA pellet in 50 μl of RNase-free water. Seed 10 7 Huh7.5.1 cells into a 10 cm tissue culture plate and incubate overnight. To electroporate 10 μg vRNA into 10 7 Huh7.5.1 cells to produce continuous HCV cultures: Wash Huh7.5.1 cells with 5 ml PBS. Add 2 ml of Trypsin and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min. Add 5 ml of 10% FBS media and harvest cell suspension into a 15 ml conical tube. Centrifuge cells at 400 × g for 4 min. Resuspend cell pellet in 5 ml of PBS. Centrifuge cells at 400 × g for 4 min. Resuspend cell pellet with 5 ml of CytoMix. Cytomix recipe can be found below under “Recipes”. Centrifuge cells at 400 × g for 4 min. Resuspend cell pellet in 400 μl of CytoMix and transfer to a 4 mm GenePulser cuvette. Mix 10 μg of viral RNA into cell suspension inside cuvette and gently pipet up and down to mix. Electroporate RNA-cell mixture using the Bio-Rad GenePulser XCell. Settings set to 950 μF capacitance, 270 V, ∞ resistance and 4 mm cuvette size. Allow cells to rest at room temperature for 10 min. Transfer electroporated cells to a fresh 10 cm culture dish with 10 ml of 10% FBS media (see Recipes). Culture electroporated cells for up to two weeks in 10% FBS media, passaging every 3-4 days as required. As you passage, expand the culture. Typically, cultures of 10 7 electroporated cells are expanded into either five or ten T150 flasks. This gives HCV time to spread and generates a culture with a higher percentage of cells that are infected and productively synthesizing progeny virus. Further expansion of cells to larger capacity can be done if needed. Convert JFH1 cultures to Human Serum Media ( Steenbergen et al. , 2013 ). Growth of HCV in human serum has two benefits. First, Huh7.5.1 cells differentiate and cease cell division, therefore trypsinization and biweekly passage are no longer required. Instead, virus containing cell supernatants can simply be collected biweekly and directly replaced with fresh medium. Second, growth in Human Serum Media increases viral yield by 10 to 100-fold. Simultaneous infection with two HCV strains and detection of co-infected cells with Prime-Flow. The description of this protocol has been adapted from the PrimeFlow Assay user’s manual. Huh7.5.1 cells are seeded into 12-well plates at a density of 10 5 cells per well using 1 ml of 10% FBS media. In our hands, JFH1 cultured in human serum media can produce viral titers of 10 5 -10 6 focus forming units (FFU) per ml. steps.title: Design codon‑altered sequences
steps.instruction: Use the Thermo Fisher GeneArt gene optimizer to design three ~1,000‑nt codon‑altered regions of the JFH1 genome, targeting ~25 % nucleotide changes and flanking each region with convenient restriction sites.

steps.title: Order synthetic gene fragments
steps.instruction: Submit the designed sequences to GeneArt for synthesis; receive each fragment cloned into a plasmid with an antibiotic‑resistance marker.

steps.title: Subclone into viral genome plasmid
steps.instruction: Insert each codon‑altered fragment into the full‑length JFH1 plasmid by restriction digestion (using the chosen cut sites) and ligation according to standard molecular cloning protocols.

steps.title: Digest plasmid with XbaI
steps.instruction: Digest 5 µg of each plasmid with 20 U XbaI in CutSmart Buffer (final volume 25 µL) at 37 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Purify linearized DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the XbaI‑digested DNA using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcribe viral RNA
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of purified linearized plasmid as template in a MEGAscript T7 reaction; incubate at 37 °C for 6 h (temperature or time may be adjusted for yield).

steps.title: Isolate and resuspend viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract the RNA with Trizol according to the manufacturer’s protocol and resuspend the RNA pellet in 50 µL RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Seed Huh7.5.1 cells overnight
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁷ Huh7.5.1 cells in a 10 cm tissue‑culture dish containing 10 % FBS media and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight.

steps.title: Prepare cells for electroporation
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 5 mL PBS, add 2 mL 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 37 °C for 5 min, add 5 mL 10 % FBS media, collect cells into a 15 mL tube, centrifuge 400 × g 4 min, resuspend in 5 mL PBS, centrifuge 400 × g 4 min, resuspend in 5 mL CytoMix, centrifuge 400 × g 4 min, finally resuspend pellet in 400 µL CytoMix.

steps.title: Electroporate viral RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the 400 µL cell suspension to a 4 mm GenePulser cuvette, add 10 µg viral RNA, gently pipet to mix, electroporate at 950 µF, 270 V, ∞ Ω, then rest 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Culture electroporated cells
steps.instruction: Add cells to a fresh 10 cm dish with 10 mL 10 % FBS media; culture up to 2 weeks, passaging every 3–4 days (typically expanding 1 × 10⁷ cells into 5–10 T150 flasks).

steps.title: Convert to Human Serum Media
steps.instruction: Replace 10 % FBS media with Human Serum Media (2 % human AB serum, 1× Pen/Strep, 1× GlutaMAX, 1× NEAA, DMEM) to halt cell division and increase viral yield 10‑ to 100‑fold.

steps.title: Seed infection plates
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁵ Huh7.5.1 cells per well in 12‑well plates using 1 mL 10 % FBS media; incubate overnight.

steps.title: Infect with dual HCV strains
steps.instruction: Add wild‑type and codon‑altered JFH1 virus preparations (≈1–2 mL each, total 4 mL) to achieve an MOI of 1 virus particle per cell; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 4–6 h.

steps.title: Post‑infection incubation
steps.instruction: Aspirate inoculum, add fresh 10 % FBS media, and incubate 72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Drug treatment (optional)
steps.instruction: Replace media with 10 % FBS media containing antiviral drug or vehicle; incubate 24–36 h, then aspirate and wash cells with 1 mL PBS.

steps.title: Harvest cells for PrimeFlow
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA per well, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 5 min, neutralize with 1 mL 10 % FBS media, transfer all cells to 1.5 mL microfuge tubes, spin 400 × g 5 min, aspirate to the 100 µL mark, wash with 1 mL Flow Cytometry Staining Buffer, vortex, spin 400 × g 5 min.

steps.title: Fix cells (PrimeFlow)
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1 mL Fixation Buffer 1, incubate 4 °C 30 min, spin 800 × g 5 min, resuspend in 1 mL Permeabilization Buffer, spin 800 × g 5 min; repeat Permeabilization Buffer wash 3 ×, then resuspend in 1 mL Fixation Buffer 2, incubate RT 60 min in the dark, spin 800 × g 5 min, resuspend in 1 mL Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Hybridize Target Probes
steps.instruction: Dilute Target Probes 1:20 in Target Probe Diluent, add 100 µL to each cell sample, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 2 h (or overnight).

steps.title: Wash after Target Probe
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Wash Buffer, vortex, spin 800 × g 5 min; repeat wash once.

steps.title: Pre‑amplification step
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL PreAmp Mix, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1.5 h; wash twice with 1 mL Wash Buffer as above.

steps.title: Amplification step
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL Amp Mix, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1.5 h; wash twice with 1 mL Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Label Probe hybridization
steps.instruction: Prepare Label Probe mix (Label Probes 1:100 in Label Probe Diluent), add 100 µL to cells, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1 h; wash twice with 1 mL Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Final resuspension and analysis
steps.instruction: Aspirate Wash Buffer leaving ~100 µL, pipet to resuspend, transfer to a BD FACS tube containing 250 µL PBS, analyze on a flow cytometer and process data with FlowJo.

steps.title: Plate cells for microscopy
steps.instruction: Place 1 × 10⁵ Huh7.5.1 cells on a Micro Cover Glass in a 12‑well plate; incubate 24 h for adherence.

steps.title: Infect for microscopy
steps.instruction: Co‑infect with wild‑type and codon‑altered JFH1 at MOI = 1 per cell; after 6 h replace inoculum with 1 mL 10 % FBS media.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: At 24 h post‑infection, wash 2 × 1 mL PBS, add 400 µL Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer, incubate 30 min RT; wash 3 × 800 µL PBS.

steps.title: Block and stain protein
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Blocking/Antibody Diluent, incubate 20 min RT; add primary antibody diluted in 400 µL Blocking/Antibody Diluent, incubate 1 h RT; wash 3 × PBS; add secondary antibody (e.g., anti‑mouse AlexaFluor‑647 1:200) in 400 µL Blocking/Antibody Diluent, incubate 1 h RT; wash 3 × PBS.

steps.title: Post‑protein fixation
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Fixation Solution, incubate in the dark 1 h RT; wash 3 × PBS.

steps.title: Hybridize RNA probes (microscopy)
steps.instruction: Dilute Target Probes 1:100 in Target Probe Diluent, add 400 µL to each well, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 2 h; wash 3 × 800 µL Wash Buffer RT.

steps.title: Pre‑amplifier incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute Pre‑amplifiers 1:25 in Amplifier Diluent, add 400 µL to each well, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1 h; wash 3 × 800 µL Wash Buffer RT.

steps.title: Amplifier incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute Amplifiers 1:25 in Amplifier Diluent, add 400 µL, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1 h; wash 3 × 800 µL Wash Buffer RT.

steps.title: Label Probe incubation (microscopy)
steps.instruction: Dilute Label Probes 1:100 in Label Probe Diluent, add 400 µL, incubate 40 ± 1 °C for 1 h; wash 3 × 800 µL Wash Buffer RT.

steps.title: Mount with DAPI
steps.instruction: Dilute DAPI 1:100 in Permafluor mounting reagent, spot 12.5 µL on a Micro Slide, place the stained Cover Glass cell‑side down onto the drop, let harden ≥4 h.

steps.title: Image by confocal microscopy
steps.instruction: Visualize cells on a Leica SP8 confocal microscope (White Light Laser) and acquire images.

steps.title: Prepare Human Serum Media
steps.instruction: Combine 2 % human AB serum, 1× Pen/Strep, 1× GlutaMAX, 1× non‑essential amino acids, and DMEM; filter through a 0.2 µm Rapid‑Flow Filter Unit.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % FBS Media
steps.instruction: Mix 10 % fetal bovine serum with 1× Pen/Strep, 1× GlutaMAX, 1× non‑essential amino acids, and DMEM; filter through a 0.2 µm Rapid‑Flow Filter Unit.

steps.title: Prepare CytoMix
steps.instruction: Mix 120 mM KCl, 0.15 mM CaCl₂, 10 mM K₂HPO₄, 25 mM HEPES, 2 mM EDTA, 5 mM MgCl₂; adjust pH to 7.6 and filter through a 0.2 µm Rapid‑Flow Filter Unit.
